aboutSubheading: We don't do standard. We do yours.
aboutText: BuildSpace Constructions has been designing and building bespoke homes across Melbourne's bayside and inner-eastern suburbs for over 15 years. Founded by head builder Mark De Silva, our team brings a hands-on, personal approach to every project — whether it's a knockdown rebuild in Brighton or a architect-designed new home in Toorak. We believe your home should be as unique as you are.

servicesSubheading: From concept to completion, we handle every stage of your custom build.
servicesText: Whether you're dreaming of a brand-new custom home, extending your current place, or starting fresh with a knockdown rebuild — BuildSpace Constructions has the experience and dedication to bring your vision to life. Every project gets our full attention, no shortcuts.

services.title: Custom Home Design & Build
services.desc: Work directly with our team to design and construct a one-of-a-kind home tailored to your lifestyle, block, and budget. No catalogues, no compromises.

services.title: Home Extensions & Additions
services.desc: Need more space? We design and build seamless extensions — from extra bedrooms and second storeys to outdoor entertaining areas that flow perfectly from your existing home.

services.title: Expert Builder Consultation
services.desc: Not sure where to start? Book a one-on-one consultation with our head builder to map out your project, discuss feasibility, and get honest advice before you commit.

services.title: Knockdown & Rebuild
services.desc: Love your location but not your house? We'll demolish and rebuild a stunning custom home on your existing block — maximising every square metre.

services.title: Full Home Renovations
services.desc: Transform tired spaces into modern masterpieces. We handle complete interior and exterior renovations, including structural changes, kitchens, bathrooms, and more.

services.title: Project Management
services.desc: From council permits to handover, we manage every trade, every timeline, and every detail so your build runs smoothly and stress-free from start to finish.

bannerHeading: Your Home Shouldn't Look Like Everyone Else's
bannerSubheading: Every BuildSpace home is designed from scratch — because your family, your lifestyle, and your block are one of a kind.
testimonialsSubheading: Real stories from real homeowners across Melbourne who trusted BuildSpace with their dream build.

testimonials.text: We spoke to half a dozen volume builders before finding BuildSpace. The difference was night and day. Mark actually listened to what we wanted and designed a home that works perfectly for our family. Couldn't be happier with the result in our new Mentone place.
testimonials.name: Sarah Mitchell

testimonials.text: As a developer, I've worked with plenty of builders. BuildSpace stands out because they genuinely care about quality and communication. They delivered our boutique townhouse project in Hampton on time and under budget. Already planning the next one with them.
testimonials.name: Dave Thompson

testimonials.text: We did a knockdown rebuild on our old block in Brighton East and the whole process was so much smoother than we expected. The team kept us updated every step of the way, and the finished home is absolutely everything we dreamed of. Highly recommend!
testimonials.name: Emma & Josh Carter
